description: Two XML weaknesses that live on the same call and are not the same thing. huge_tree lifts the guard against a small document expanding into a large one; the default parser expands entities. A supplied parser is where the fix goes and the engine cannot see how one was built, so it says nothing about those -- a stated miss rather than a claim that they are safe.

expected.note: the guard against a small document expanding into a large one, removed by name
no parser supplied, so lxml's default is used: it expands internal entities, and before lxml 5 it resolved external ones as well
